==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Bunit&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.Bunit: renders a component through bUnit and writes its markup as an html snapshot.
        // excludeComponent decides whether the component's own state is written alongside the markup.
        VerifyBunit.Initialize(excludeComponent: false);

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/BunitTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Bunit&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Bunit;

// Verify.Bunit: Snapshots a bUnit rendered Blazor component, with bUnit's full interaction api available first.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Bunit
// Note: The samples use the bUnit v2 api, BunitContext and context.Render<T>(...), not v1's
// TestContext and RenderComponent.
// Note: Verify.Bunit has no stable release on Verify 33 yet, so a prerelease version is
// referenced.
// Note: VerifyBunit.Initialize() registers bUnit's own markup comparer for html, which
// Verify.AngleSharp also does.
// Note: component.WaitFor(...) and context.RenderComponentAndWait(...) let a test verify a
// component that renders again after an async call.
// Note: The package suppresses BL0005 for the project that references it.
public class BunitTests
{
    // The parameters are set through bUnit's builder, so they are checked against the component's
    // properties at compile time rather than matched by name at run time.
    [Fact]
    public Task Component()
    {
        using var context = new BunitContext();
        var component = context.Render<BunitComponent>(
            _ =>
            {
                _.Add(parameter => parameter.Title, "The Title");
                _.Add(parameter => parameter.Name, "Sam");
            });
        return Verify(component);
    }

    // Verifying the nodes, or a single node, snapshots only that markup: useful when a test is
    // about one part of a page and the rest changes for unrelated reasons.
    [Fact]
    public Task Nodes()
    {
        using var context = new BunitContext();
        var component = context.Render<BunitComponent>(
            _ => _.Add(parameter => parameter.Title, "The Title"));
        return Verify(component.Nodes);
    }
}
